newsitem.title: USA: LecTec expects improved fiscal '97 results.
newsitem.headline: LecTec expects improved fiscal '97 results.

text.p: LecTec Corp said Thursday it expects to report substantially improved full-year fiscal 1997 results, excluding a restructuring charge, compared with the loss of $632,000 or $0.17 a share in fiscal 1996.

Earlier today, Lectec reported a loss for its fiscal third quarter ended March 31, 1997 of $1.47 million or $0.38 which included a nonrecurring restructuring charge of $1.50 million or $0.39 a share related to the company's previously announced plan to eliminate its Pharmadyne Corp subsidiary.

Excluding this one-time charge, Lectec reported a profit of $31,000 or $0.01 in its fiscal 1997 third quarter. Fiscal 1997 results benefited from the elimination of substantial selling, general and administrative expenses associated with the former Natus direct marketing activities.
Fiscal third quarter sales fell to $3.3 million from $3.8 million a year earlier. Fiscal 1996 sales were boosted by sales of a former Natus Corp subsidiary and a major international order.
LecTec develops, makes and markets products based on its skin-interface technologies including over-the-counter analgesic patches.
